name: ZX_PROCESS_RESULTS_
description: This table stores the results from the evaluation for tax rules. Each record stores the process result from the evaluation of a specific condition set in a tax rule.

columns.name: CONDITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Condition group code for which this process result is defined

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority order for this process result in which the condition groups using the same determining factor template are evaluated to obtain this result

columns.name: RESULT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicates the type of this process result

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code for this process result

columns.name: NUMERIC_RESULT
columns.description: Column to store the numeric result value for this process result

columns.name: ALPHANUMERIC_RESULT
columns.description: Column to store the alphanumeric result value for this process result

columns.name: STATUS_RESULT
columns.description: Tax status code pointed by this process result when the condition group evaluates to be true

columns.name: RATE_RESULT
columns.description: Tax rate code pointed by this process result when the condition group evaluates to be true

columns.name: LEGAL_MESSAGE_CODE
columns.description: Legal mnessage code pointed by this process result when the condition group evaluates to be true

columns.name: MIN_TAX_AMT
columns.description: Minimum threshold for tax amount pointed by this process result when the condition group evaluates to be true

columns.name: MAX_TAX_AMT
columns.description: Maximum threshold for tax amount pointed by this process result when the condition group evaluates to be true

columns.name: MIN_TAXABLE_BASIS
columns.description: Minimum threshold for taxable basis pointed by this process result when the condition group evaluates to be true

columns.name: MAX_TAXABLE_BASIS
columns.description: Maximum threshold for taxable basis pointed by this process result when the condition group evaluates to be true

columns.name: MIN_TAX_RATE
columns.description: Minimum threshold for tax rate pointed by this process result when the condition group evaluates to be true

columns.name: MAX_TAX_RATE
columns.description: Maximum threshold for tax rate pointed by this process result when the condition group evaluates to be true

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if this process result is enabled

columns.name: ALLOW_EXEMPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether exemptions are applicable for this process result

columns.name: ALLOW_EXCEPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether exceptions are applicable for this process result

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: CONDITION_SET_ID
columns.description: Condition set identifier for this process result

columns.name: EXCEPTION_SET_ID
columns.description: Exception set identifier for this process result

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: RESULT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for configuration owner of this process result

columns.name: CONDITION_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Condition group identifier for which this process result is defined

columns.name: TAX_RULE_ID
columns.description: Tax rule identifier for which this process result is defined

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: RESULT_API
columns.description: API pointed by this process result when the condition group evaluates to be true

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TAX_POINT_BASIS_RESULT
columns.description: Column to store the tax point basis value for this process result.

columns.name: SELF_ASSESED_FLAG
columns.description: Column to store self assessed flag value for this process result.

columns.name: INCLUSIVE_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Column to store inclusive tax flag g value for this process result.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_THRSHLD_CODE
columns.description: Code for the associated tax rate threshold.

columns.name: TAXABLE_AMT_THRSHLD_CODE
columns.description: Code for the associated taxable amount threshold.

columns.name: TAX_AMT_THRSHLD_CODE
columns.description: Code for the associated tax amount threshold.

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASIS_FORMULA_RESULT
columns.description: Tax formula code in the process result for which the rule condition is successfully evaluated.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
